core.firstsword_core.meteor.desc: Meteor shower cooldown -10s, rainbow lightning damage +6
core.firstsword_core.qinghuo.desc: Meteor-hit mobs burn for 7s (8 damage/s); grants you 12s fire resistance and absorption
core.firstsword_core.devastation.desc: Meteor shower adds 5-6 medium meteors (36 damage / radius 3); field radius x1.5 with matching small meteor count
core.firstsword_core.breach.desc: Tapping the meteor key (no charge) summons no meteors; instead grants 12s Resistance II + Strength II and stores 3 blast strikes (12 damage / 3x3 area), each exploding on the target you hit
core.firstsword_core.gravity.desc: Before the big meteor lands, a radius-8 gravity field pulls mobs toward the impact point and slows them 50%; grabbed mobs take x1.4 meteor damage
core.firstsword_core.echo.desc: Blink Strike stores 3 charges (same cooldown); each target hit heals 2 HP, up to 6 per dash
core.firstsword_core.sonata.desc: Rapidly press Left -> Right -> Left to trigger a combo: on top of Blink Strike, horizontal rainbow lightning erupts in three waves along your dash, filling a 15x7x7 box (20 bolts per wave, the vanilla lightning pillar laid flat); Blink Strike and the combo grant 8s Speed II + Haste II, and the combo additionally grants Jump Boost II + Regeneration II
core.firstsword_core.senra.desc: Rainbow lightning ignores blocks: it spawns at your current height and pierces downward, so it hits mobs below you and works in the Nether, caves and indoors; radius x1.4 (30 -> 42 blocks)
tooltip.firstsword_core.core.howto: Hold in your main hand with the First Sword in the offhand, then right-click
message.firstsword_core.need_sword: Hold the First Sword in your other hand
message.firstsword_core.already: This sword already has that core
message.firstsword_core.drop.convergence: The First Sword condenses - obtained "Convergence Core"
message.firstsword_core.drop.devastation: The totem's power condenses - obtained "Devastation Core"
message.firstsword_core.drop.breach: The Nether's breath pours into the blade - obtained "Breach Core"
message.firstsword_core.breach.tap: Breach Core: Resistance II + Strength II (12s), 3 blast strikes
message.firstsword_core.breach.cooldown: Breach Core is still on cooldown
